structured_output.what_is_happening: PSI "Physical Superintelligence" is a pump.fun token that migrated to PumpSwap about 55 minutes before detection. It is named after a real AI-for-physics startup, Physical Superintelligence PBC, co-founded by Matthew Pines, Alex Wissner-Gross and Alex Klokus. The startup launched in September 2026 with a $58M seed round led by Breakthrough Energy Ventures. The token description says "Fees to @matthew_pines via UsePaid", so a third party launched it and pointed creator fees at the founder. Nothing I found shows Pines has acknowledged it. The linked tweet is from texashedge17154, a recycled X account formerly named paleocore. It pumped about 150-190% in its first hour on $380k volume against roughly $120k market cap. It is now about 50% below its all-time high (ATH 0.000251 vs 0.000124 now) and fell 15-37% in the last 5 minutes.

narrative.description: A real, well-funded AI-for-physics startup, with a memecoin that routes fees to the founder via UsePaid in the 'fees to a founder or celebrity' style.
narrative.why_spreading: Real news: a $58M seed round, an AI-superintelligence theme and a named founder with an X following. The UsePaid fee mechanic invites hope that the founder will claim or acknowledge the token. I found no posts from the founder or from organic accounts about this token.

token_connection.why_this_token: It has the most liquidity and volume of the many same-name clones and was the first to migrate. But it is an unofficial third-party launch and the company has not endorsed it.
token_connection.competing_tokens: At least 8 other 'Physical Superintelligence' PSI clones launched within minutes of each other. Most are dead; FYFCAf... had $133k of h1 volume with near-zero liquidity.

authenticity.evidence: GMGN counts 300 bundler wallets, 401 fresh wallets and a 66% bot/degen rate. The creator wallet has launched 5,792 tokens (a serial launcher) and has closed out its position. The project X account has been renamed twice. On the other side, 1,184 unique buyers, 37 smart wallets and 5 KOL wallets were present, and holders are spread out (top10 21.6%).
authenticity.uncertainty: I could not see X, so I don't know how much genuine CT discussion exists or whether Pines has reacted.

structural_risks: Serial-launcher creator (5,792 tokens) has already exited

structured_output.thesis: A real, fresh narrative attached to the canonical unofficial token. But the token has already halved from its ATH and the structure is weak: a serial-launcher dev, heavy bundling, and no sign the founder has endorsed it. Doubling from here needs a founder acknowledgment or a new catalyst. Slightly above the base rate at best.
